author: hdprajwal
abstract: Turns a rough idea into an approved design before any code is written. Reads project context, asks clarifying questions one at a time, proposes 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, presents the design section by section, writes a short spec to docs/specs/, self-reviews it, and gets user sign-off before handing off to writing-plans. Adapted from obra/superpowers' brainstorming skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
